evidence.observation: Tube pressure rising monotonically through growth: 3.01→3.07→3.12→3.19→3.25 Torr since t=2640, while Ar flow and T hold at setpoint
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not commanded
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed — atmosphere/air-ingress cannot be verified

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or a pump-down/flow-step test: close Ar and watch pressure decay) would distinguish a seal leak (air ingress, O2 rise) from exhaust blockage (pressure rises with no O2 change).
